title: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
title_zh: 基准即软件：Terminal-Bench与持续性基准的案例

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt : a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体是迄今为止大语言模型最具经济影响力的应用之一，这使得可靠的评估变得越来越重要。 然而，即使是发布时经过仔细验证的基准测试也会变得过时。 随着模型的改进，它们可能找到被现有验证器拒绝的有效解决方案，而评估基础设施的变更则可能使任务和测试中蕴含的假设失效。 我们将由此累积的缺陷称为基准测试维护债务：即基准测试分数与其本意所衡量的能力之间不断扩大的差距。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman ρ = 0.958 \rho=0.958 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种针对智能体基准的持续验证工作流，它结合了社区报告、任务工件、智能体轨迹、自动化判定检查以及由人工把关的修复。 我们将该工作流应用于 Terminal-Bench 2.0，这一基准在发布前经过了大量人工和语言模型辅助的审查与红队测试。 我们的审计发现该基准中约 30% 的任务存在问题，并将由此产生的修复版本以 Terminal-Bench 2.1 的形式发布。 这些修复改变了评测结果：准确率提升了超过 10 个百分点，排行榜排名最多移动三位，尽管整体排名仍然高度相关（Spearman ρ = 0.958 \rho=0.958 ）。

paragraphs.en: Beyond accuracy, we evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock and output-token budgets can materially change apparent agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20 pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 除了准确率之外，我们还评估了资源分配如何影响基准测试的结论。 我们证明，固定的墙钟时间和输出 token 预算会显著改变智能体的表面性能：例如，延长时间上限可以弥合 GPT 5.4 上 20 个百分点的测试框架差距，并将 GPT 5.4 mini 上 30 个百分点的差距缩小到 5 个百分点。 因此，基准测试的维护不仅仅是修复任务工件：资源预算是测量规范的一部分，必须与任务本身一同进行验证。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, our results highlight that benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated bugs: benchmarks sit in an evolving ecosystem of dependencies, infrastructure, and agents, so their assumptions and resource settings must be revalidated over time.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，我们的研究结果强调，基准测试维护债不仅仅是累积的错误：基准测试处于一个由依赖项、基础设施和智能体组成的不断演化的生态系统中，因此它们的假设和资源配置必须随时间推移不断重新验证。

paragraphs.en: Agentic benchmark scores shape product claims and research investment. But agentic benchmarks are not static datasets: over time, these systems accumulate defects that decouple a model’s score from the capability the benchmark is meant to measure. In turn benchmark maintenance debt , the backlog of task-side defects that must be repaired or retired for benchmarks to remain valid. These surface along the agentic-task lifecycle as shown in Fig. 1 : benchmark designers can encode assumptions about how agents will solve a task, which break when agents find valid solution paths the designer did not anticipate, or shortcuts that pass the tests without solving the task. Furthermore, tasks that depend on external state (packages, APIs, websites) can break when that state changes after release, causing failures unrelated to agent capability.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体基准测试的分数会影响产品宣传与研究投入。 但智能体基准测试并非静态数据集：随着时间的推移，这些系统会积累缺陷，使模型的分数与基准测试本应衡量的能力脱钩。 由此产生了基准测试维护债，即为了使基准测试保持有效而必须修复或淘汰的任务侧缺陷的积压。 如图 1 所示，这些问题会沿着智能体任务的生命周期浮现：基准测试的设计者可能对智能体如何解决任务做出假设，而当智能体找到设计者未预料到的有效解题路径，或找到能通过测试却并未真正解决任务的捷径时，这些假设就会失效。 此外，依赖外部状态（软件包、API、网站）的任务可能在该状态发布后发生变化时失效，导致与智能体能力无关的失败。

paragraphs.en: For agentic benchmarks, validity requires ongoing maintenance. Terminal-Bench 2.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) illustrates this need: its tasks underwent human review, LM-assisted auditing, and exploit testing before release ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , yet within months its issue trackers contained over 50 open reports tagged as task defects ( Terminal-Bench Team, 2026b ; Terminal-Bench Team, 2026a ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , spanning different assumptions made across the full task stack (Fig. 1 ). Extensive release-time validation therefore does not eliminate the need for subsequent auditing and repair. Furthermore, a defect report does not establish its cause or justify a particular fix. Proposed repairs require their own validation. For example, we found some proposals addressed the underlying validity failure by clarifying the task or repairing the oracle; others only patched the observed symptom, for example by relaxing a regex or broadening an acceptance condition. Maintainers therefore need a consistent process for establishing defects, reviewing proposed changes, and checking that repairs preserve the intended task.
paragraphs.zh: 对于智能体基准测试而言，有效性需要持续的维护。 Terminal-Bench 2.0（Merrill 等，2026）说明了这一需求的必要性：其任务在发布前经过了人工审查、语言模型辅助审计以及漏洞测试（Zhu 等，2025），但仅在数月内，其问题追踪器中就积累了超过 50 份被标记为任务缺陷的未解决报告（Terminal-Bench Team，2026b；Terminal-Bench Team，2026a；Zeng 等，2026），这些报告涵盖了完整任务栈中不同层面所作的各种假设（图 1）。 因此，发布时进行的大量验证并不能消除后续审计与修复的必要性。 此外，一份缺陷报告既不能确定其原因，也不能证明某种特定修复方案的合理性。 所提出的修复方案本身也需要经过验证。 例如，我们发现有些提案通过澄清任务或修复判定标准来解决底层的有效性失效问题；而另一些提案只是修补了观察到的表象，例如放宽正则表达式或扩大接受条件。 因此，维护者需要一个一致的流程，用于确认缺陷、审查所提议的更改，并检查修复是否保留了原定的任务。

paragraphs.en: Resource allocation and infrastructure variation further complicate this process. Differences in time and memory limits, environment configuration, and model or sandbox providers can make the same task behave differently across evaluation setups, complicating both the reproduction of reported failures and the validation of repairs ( Anthropic, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2025b ) . Freezing environments trades fidelity for reproducibility, filtering questionable tasks ( OpenAI, 2024 ) trades coverage for precision, and refreshing evaluation sets ( Jain et al., 2025 ) keeps tasks unseen by models but does not fix tasks that break after release. We develop a complementary benchmark audit tool for reviewing tasks. We apply it to Terminal-Bench 2.0, release the resulting update as Terminal-Bench 2.1, and examine how the revisions affect evaluation results.

paragraphs.en: A continuous validation workflow. We show that benchmark validation can itself be continuous: modern agentic tools make it practical to combine community reports, public execution traces, agent-assisted triage, and human adjudication into a maintainable workflow for identifying, repairing, retiring, and documenting benchmark issues ( Section 4 ).

paragraphs.en: The effects of benchmark repair. We re-evaluate 19 agents on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and Terminal-Bench 2.1 and show that repair can change reported accuracy and efficiency conclusions without fully overturning the leaderboard. Agent rankings remain highly correlated, but individual scores move by nontrivial margins ( Sec. 6 ). Even with feasibility restored, we highlight the changes in performance due to resource allocation (e.g. >50% of failed trials are due to timeouts, and up to ∼ \sim 68% for some harnesses) ( Fig. 3 b).
paragraphs.zh: 基准修复的效果。 我们在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上重新评估了 19 个智能体，结果表明修复可以在不完全颠覆排行榜的情况下改变所报告的准确性和效率结论。 智能体的排名仍然高度相关，但个别分数会有不小的变动（见第 6 节）。 即使在可行性得到恢复之后，我们仍然强调由资源分配引起的性能变化（例如，超过 50% 的失败试验是由超时导致的，某些测试框架中这一比例高达约 68%）（见图 3b）。

paragraphs.en: A second response is to validate and filter benchmark instances. SWE-Bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) contracted professional developers to audit SWE-Bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and released a conservatively filtered subset. WebArena Verified ( ServiceNow Research, 2026 ) applies a similar validated-subset approach to WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Related audits identify solution leakage, weak test suites, and task/outcome-validity failures in agentic benchmarks ( aleithan2024swebenchplus ; Yu and others, 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . These approaches typically treat validation as a one-shot curation pass and reduce the benchmark rather than repairing it.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark auditing is facilitated by a growing stack of operational tools. The Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC) ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) provides rubrics for auditing outcome validity and task validity. Tools such as Docent ( Meng et al., 2025 ) and LangSmith LangChain (2026) make large-scale inspection tractable by ingesting benchmark trajectories for review. Complementary adversarial tools audit benchmark hackability by searching for ways that agents can pass tests without satisfying the intended task. These tools address different parts of the audit pipeline. Rubrics specify the evaluation criteria; ingestion tools collect evidence; red-teamers identify candidate defects; and human adjudication resolves ambiguous cases. We combine these ingredients into a continuous validation workflow ( Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基准审计正得益于日益丰富的操作性工具栈。 智能体基准清单（Agentic Benchmark Checklist，ABC）（Zhu 等，2025）为审计结果效度和任务效度提供了评分细则。 诸如 Docent（Meng 等，2025）和 LangSmith（LangChain，2026）之类的工具通过摄取基准轨迹以供审查，使大规模检查变得切实可行。 互补性的对抗工具通过搜索智能体在不满足预期任务的情况下通过测试的方式，来审计基准的可被钻空子程度。 这些工具针对审计流程的不同环节。 评分细则规定评估标准；摄取工具收集证据；红队人员识别潜在缺陷；而人工裁决解决模棱两可的个案。 我们将这些要素整合为一个持续验证工作流（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Executable agent benchmarks do not evaluate a model in isolation: scores also depend on the agent harness, the execution environment, and the resource budget. Harness effects are well documented ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Merrill et al. (2026) found that, on average, the choice of harness matters less than the choice of model. Environment effects have received less attention: Anthropic (2026c) shows that infrastructure configuration alone can shift agentic coding scores. We extend this line of work in two ways: averages can hide large within-vendor harness gaps ( ∼ 20 {\sim}20 pp for some models), and that these gaps largely reflect speed under the default time budget.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行的智能体基准测试并不是在孤立地评估模型：得分还取决于智能体框架、执行环境和资源预算。 智能体框架的影响已有充分记录（Yang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025）。Merrill 等人 （2026）发现，平均而言，框架的选择比模型的选择影响更小。 环境的影响受到的关注较少：Anthropic（2026c）表明，仅基础设施配置就能改变智能体编程的得分。 我们从两个方面扩展了这一工作：平均值可能掩盖同一厂商内部较大的框架差距（某些模型的差距约为 20 个百分点），并且这些差距在很大程度上反映了默认时间预算下的速度。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is to audit agentic benchmarks for task-side defects and to produce candidate repairs that maintainers can review. We have at our disposal three evidence streams: the task’s specification, prior execution traces, and community reports from the web. We want this evidence compiled into a task-level audit report: a defect label, supporting evidence, and a proposed fix when one is available. We define three agent workflows for collecting evidence, auditing, and verifying the final report.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是审计智能体基准测试中任务侧的缺陷，并产出可供维护者审查的候选修复方案。 我们手头有三类证据来源：任务规范、先前的执行轨迹，以及来自网络社区的报告。 我们希望将这些证据汇编成任务级审计报告：包括缺陷标签、支持证据，以及在可行时提出的修复建议。 我们定义了三个智能体工作流，分别用于收集证据、执行审计和验证最终报告。

paragraphs.en: A central requirement of the workflow is a rubric. Without one, an agent can flag suspicious behavior, but its behavior may not be consistent or easy to parse. Previous work has developed rubrics to audit benchmarks ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . We build on this idea, but adapt it for a maintenance workflow. In this setting, we found it more useful to ask for a small number of action-oriented defect labels tied to likely repairs, rather than broad free-form validity judgments. The auditor therefore assigns a primary task-side defect category and records secondary labels when applicable. sents.zh: 在这一场景中，我们发现更有益的做法是要求少量与可能修复方案相关联的、面向行动的缺陷标签，而不是宽泛的自由形式的有效性判断。

sents.en: The auditor therefore assigns a primary task-side defect category and records secondary labels when applicable.
sents.zh: 因此，审计者会指定一个主要的任务侧缺陷类别，并在适用时记录次要标签。

sents.en: This makes reports comparable across agents and gives maintainers a concrete review target.
sents.zh: 这使得报告在不同智能体之间具有可比性，并为维护者提供了具体的审查目标。

sents.en: We ask auditors to classify each task using the following primary defect categories :
sents.zh: 我们要求审计者使用以下主要缺陷类别对每个任务进行分类：

paragraphs.en: No defect found: the task is well specified, the oracle is accepted, the verifier checks the intended behavior, and the stated resource budget is sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 未发现缺陷：任务说明清晰，判定标准（oracle）被接受，验证器检查的是预期行为，且声明的资源预算充足。

paragraphs.en: Instruction–verification mismatch: the task instruction and the verifier disagree. This includes underspecified instructions whose hidden constraints appear only in tests, as well as overspecified tests that reject behavior satisfying the task as written.
paragraphs.zh: 指令—校验不匹配：任务指令与校验器不一致。 这包括欠规范的指令（其隐藏约束只出现在测试中），也包括过度规范的测试（拒绝满足字面任务描述的行为）。

sents.en: Instruction–verification mismatch: the task instruction and the verifier disagree.
sents.zh: 指令—校验不匹配：任务指令与校验器不一致。

sents.en: This includes underspecified instructions whose hidden constraints appear only in tests, as well as overspecified tests that reject behavior satisfying the task as written.
sents.zh: 这包括欠规范的指令（其隐藏约束只出现在测试中），也包括过度规范的测试（拒绝满足字面任务描述的行为）。

paragraphs.en: Task drift: the task changed after release because of mutable external state, such as package versions, network resources, public APIs, or web content.
paragraphs.zh: 任务漂移：任务在发布后因可变的外部状态而发生改变，例如软件包版本、网络资源、公共 API 或网页内容。

paragraphs.en: Environment issues: the task is solvable in principle, but the provided environment and resources (CPU, memory, storage, or system/network configuration) prevent the oracle, the verifier, or a valid agent solution from running reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 环境问题：任务原则上可解，但所提供的环境和资源（CPU、内存、存储或系统/网络配置）导致标准答案（oracle）、验证器或有效的智能体解决方案无法可靠运行。

paragraphs.en: The audit workflow is illustrated in Figure 2 . For each task, the evidence agent produces a structured report containing information on the benchmark, the task specification, trace information, and community reports. The role of this agent is to organize available evidence for a downstream auditor, while keeping observation separate from adjudication.
paragraphs.zh: 审计流程如图2所示。 对于每个任务，证据智能体会生成一份结构化报告，其中包含基准信息、任务规范、轨迹信息以及社区报告。 该智能体的作用是为下游的审计员整理可用证据，同时将观察与裁定分开。

sents.zh: 审计流程如图2所示。

paragraphs.en: An auditor applies the rubric to each task. The auditor checks whether the task is well specified, solvable, verifiable, and whether the verifier accepts valid solutions and rejects invalid ones. The rubric here follows the ABC guidelines ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and it produces a task-level report containing a primary defect label, a short justification, the location of the defect, and a proposed repair.
paragraphs.zh: 审计员对每个任务应用该评分规则。 审计员检查任务是否被良好定义、是否可解、是否可验证，以及验证器是否接受有效解并拒绝无效解。 这里的评分规则遵循 ABC 指南（Zhu et al., 2025），它会生成一份任务级报告，其中包含主要缺陷标签、简要理由、缺陷位置以及建议的修复方案。

sents.en: An auditor applies the rubric to each task.
sents.zh: 审计员对每个任务应用该评分规则。

sents.en: The rubric here follows the ABC guidelines ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and it produces a task-level report containing a primary defect label, a short justification, the location of the defect, and a proposed repair.

The verifier agent is asked to run the oracle, challenge the proposed label, identify missing evidence, and check whether the proposed fix addresses the underlying defect. The full breakdown is in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Once a defect is identified, the repair is not always mechanical, but involves human judgment ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . We follow these conventions for each defect category:
paragraphs.zh: 一旦识别出缺陷，修复并不总是机械性的，而是需要人工判断（Zhu 等，2025）。 我们针对每个缺陷类别遵循以下惯例：

sents.en: Once a defect is identified, the repair is not always mechanical, but involves human judgment ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 一旦识别出缺陷，修复并不总是机械性的，而是需要人工判断（Zhu 等，2025）。

sents.en: We follow these conventions for each defect category:
sents.zh: 我们针对每个缺陷类别遵循以下惯例：

paragraphs.en: Instruction–verification mismatch : any solution satisfying the task as written is accepted, and invalid solutions are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 指令–验证不匹配：任何满足任务描述要求的解都会被接受，无效的解则会被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Task drift : make the dependency reproducible where possible and remove any dependency that prevents the oracle from running reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 任务漂移：尽可能使依赖可复现，并移除任何妨碍预言机（oracle）可靠运行的依赖。

paragraphs.en: Environment Issues: We set a feasibility floor : a known-correct oracle solution and the verifier should run reliably within the benchmark budget.
paragraphs.zh: 环境问题：我们设定了一个可行性底线：一个已知正确的参考（oracle）解法以及验证器应当能够在基准测试的预算范围内可靠地运行。

paragraphs.en: For resource-related failures, we adjust the binding resource axes (wall-clock time, memory, or CPU count; sometimes more than one) to the factor closest to the original proposal or at least 1.5 × 1.5\times the observed requirement of the oracle solution and verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 对于与资源相关的失败，我们将绑定的资源轴（挂钟时间、内存或 CPU 数量；有时不止一个）调整为最接近原始提案的因子，或至少为预言机解决方案和验证器所观测需求的 1.5 × 1.5\times 倍。

paragraphs.en: This convention serves two purposes. First, it prevents false negatives caused by infrastructure noise: a correct solution should not fail because the verifier or oracle only barely fits within the budget, but we should leave enough slack for the problem to be solved. Second, the resource sets the task difficulty, and here we leave those as close to what the original task contributors intended.
paragraphs.zh: 这一约定有两个目的。 首先，它防止由基础设施噪音造成的假阴性：一个正确的解不应仅仅因为验证器或参考答案勉强符合预算而失败，但我们应留出足够的余量使问题能够被解决。 其次，资源决定了任务难度，在这里我们将这些资源保持在尽可能接近原始任务贡献者所设定的水平。

sents.en: This convention serves two purposes.
sents.zh: 这一约定有两个目的。

sents.en: First, it prevents false negatives caused by infrastructure noise: a correct solution should not fail because the verifier or oracle only barely fits within the budget, but we should leave enough slack for the problem to be solved.
sents.zh: 首先，它防止由基础设施噪音造成的假阴性：一个正确的解不应仅仅因为验证器或参考答案勉强符合预算而失败，但我们应留出足够的余量使问题能够被解决。

sents.en: Second, the resource sets the task difficulty, and here we leave those as close to what the original task contributors intended.
sents.zh: 其次，资源决定了任务难度，在这里我们将这些资源保持在尽可能接近原始任务贡献者所设定的水平。

paragraphs.en: An alternative would be to tune resource budgets per task. However, doing so would require repeated sweeps over any resource and would introduce an additional subjective design choice into the process. While the feasibility rule is conservative, it is an auditable convention.
paragraphs.zh: 一种替代方案是为每个任务调整资源预算。 然而，这样做需要对任何资源进行反复扫描，并会给流程引入一个额外的主观设计选择。 尽管可行性规则较为保守，但它是一种可审计的约定。

sents.en: An alternative would be to tune resource budgets per task.

paragraphs.en: When tasks depend on live APIs, the difficulty can change after the audit. When a repair changes task difficulty, we document the change rather than tuning the task back to match its previous pass rate by following expert guidelines.
paragraphs.zh: 当任务依赖实时 API 时，审计之后难度可能会发生变化。 当某次修复改变了任务难度时，我们会按照专家指南记录这一变化，而不是通过调整任务使其恢复到之前的通过率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the audit workflow in the setting it was designed for: post-release benchmark maintenance. We used the workflow during Terminal-Bench 2.0 maintenance to surface candidate task defects, attach evidence, and propose repairs for maintainer review. The accepted repairs were then shipped as Terminal-Bench 2.1.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在审计流程的设计目标场景——基准发布后维护——中对其进行评估。 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 的维护过程中，我们使用该流程来发现候选任务缺陷、附上证据，并提出修复方案供维护者审核。 被采纳的修复方案随后作为 Terminal-Bench 2.1 发布。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the workflow along three dimensions. First, we ask whether the workflow is agent-agnostic: under the same rubric, do different auditors assign similar defect labels? Second, we ask whether this agreement persists when the workflow is instantiated with lower-cost auditor models. Third, we evaluate the workflow as a maintainer-in-the-loop triage system by comparing its flags against a human-adjudicated set of repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个维度评估该工作流。 首先，我们探究该工作流是否对智能体不敏感（agent-agnostic）：在相同的评分标准下，不同的审计智能体是否会给出相似的缺陷标注？ 其次，我们探究当该工作流使用成本更低的审计模型实例化时，这种一致性是否依然存在。 第三，我们将该工作流作为一个维护者在回路中的分流系统进行评估，将其标记结果与经人工裁定的一组修复进行对比。

The defect categories were selected based on results from a 15-task pilot subset of Terminal-Bench 2.0 and approximately 1,500 TB2.0 execution trials. The pilot fixed only the category definitions, not per-task labels.

paragraphs.en: To prevent leakage from the community reports the workflow is designed to consume, all evaluation runs disable the auditors’ web-search tools; in deployment, web search stays on.

paragraphs.en: Against the final TB2.1 release, the workflow reaches 57.1% precision and 71.4% recall. paragraphs.en: The third category, environment issues (29% of tasks), comes from resource budgets. In TB2.0, task contributors set CPU, memory, and time budgets for each task based on their own resource use. These estimates were sometimes too tight (Fig. 3 c): the oracle solution, the verifier, or the agent hit or reached its memory or disk limit, so trials could fail because of resource limits rather than incorrect solutions. Execution backends (Docker, Daytona) also differ in how they isolate filesystems, enforce memory limits, and expose networks between agent and verifier. The audit raises the binding budgets so the oracle runs with at least 1.5 × 1.5\times slack on each, restoring a feasibility floor.
paragraphs.zh: 第三类问题是环境问题（占任务的 29%），来源于资源预算。 在 TB2.0 中，任务贡献者根据自身的资源使用情况，为每个任务设置 CPU、内存和时间预算。 这些估计有时过于紧张（图 3 c）：参考解、验证器或智能体达到或触及了其内存或磁盘上限，因此试验可能因资源限制而非解法错误而失败。 不同的执行后端（Docker、Daytona）在隔离文件系统、强制内存限制以及暴露智能体与验证器之间网络的方式上也各不相同。 审计会调高这些绑定预算，使参考解在每项资源上至少拥有 1.5 × 1.5\times 的余量，从而恢复一个可行性下限。

paragraphs.en: The performance of an agent is a product of the model, harness and resources ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Kapoor et al., 2026 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . While we generally compare model and harness, here we show the impact of resources as well. We use TB2.1 to ask which conclusions are stable under changes to this measurement stack. First, we compare TB2.0 and TB2.1 at the default protocol to test whether repairs change accuracy and rankings. Second, we vary the time budget to test whether repairs change the efficiency frontier: which agents solve tasks, and how much budget they need to do so. Third, we ask how much of a fixed-budget harness gap is explained by speed under the timeout. Scalar leaderboards hide these distinctions because they collapse benchmark version, harness, and resource budget into one number.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的表现是模型、工具框架与资源共同作用的结果（Yang 等，2024；Kapoor 等，2026；Merrill 等，2026）。 虽然我们通常比较模型与工具框架，但这里我们同时展示资源的影响。 我们利用 TB2.1 来探究哪些结论在测量栈变化下依然稳定。 首先，我们在默认协议下比较 TB2.0 与 TB2.1，以检验修复是否会改变准确率和排名。 其次，我们改变时间预算，以检验修复是否会改变效率前沿：哪些智能体能解决任务，以及它们需要多少预算才能做到。 第三，我们探究在超时限制下，固定预算的工具框架差距中有多少可以用速度差异来解释。 单一标量排行榜掩盖了这些区别，因为它把基准版本、工具框架和资源预算压缩成一个数字。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 19 agents from multiple providers and compare the accuracy in both TB 2.0 and TB 2.1, as illustrated in Figure 4 . The correlation is high (Spearman ρ = 0.958 \rho=0.958 ), with an OLS fit of TB2.1 = 2.1 + 1.04 ⋅ TB2.0 \text{TB2.1}=2.1+1.04\,\cdot\,\text{TB2.0} . The lift is uneven: Claude Code + Claude Opus 4.6 lifts over 7 7 pp above the fit and climbs three places, while Codex + GPT 5.4 sits below the fit. The two weakest agents, which fall below 40% on TB 2.0 accuracy, both fall below the fit and lose accuracy on TB 2.1. This is consistent with the difficulty of the repaired tasks: 19 of the 28 repaired tasks were hard, 7 medium, and 2 easy, so repairs that make hard tasks solvable matter little to agents that rarely solve them.

paragraphs.en: The largest gains are concentrated among tasks with instruction–verification mismatches. In TB 2.1, five tasks increased from pass rates of at most 15 % 15\% to over 50 % 50\% after repairs centered on the verifier, accounting for roughly 62.7 % 62.7\% of the total absolute pass-rate change on the modified-task subset (full breakdown in Appendix C ). paragraphs.en: Setting resources for executable agent benchmarks is non-trivial. A task score depends not only on whether an agent can solve the task, but also on whether it can solve it within the allocated resources. Figure 3 b shows that over 50% of failed trials ended due to timeout, ranging from 68% under claude-code to 18% under gemini-cli ; for the weakest agent–model pairs, timeouts dominate ( Sec. C.2 ).

paragraphs.en: We therefore evaluate the test-time scaling properties of these models. For each agent–model pair, we increase the wall-clock budget up to 32 × 32\times the original task timeout and measure how many tasks are solved as the budget increases. This larger budget is an upper bound: agents can exit once they finish, so they do not need to consume the full allocation. Few timeouts remain at the largest budget, except for the small models included (Qwen 3.5), so most remaining failures are not timeout artifacts: these tasks stayed unsolved under the tested configurations.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has shown that harnesses and agent-computer interfaces affect agent performance ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Kapoor et al., 2026 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . We ask: how much of a fixed-budget harness gap disappears when the slower harness is moved along the efficiency frontier?

However, most of the harness gap is recovered when we give the tasks a longer budget, suggesting speed rather than capability gains.

paragraphs.en: The results here show that a fixed resource budget is an arbitrary operating point and that the choice is not innocuous: it can change efficiency conclusions for individual models. This supports setting a principled floor and testing sensitivity to the budget, rather than calibrating to any one choice of agents and models.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether the workflow transfers beyond Terminal-Bench, we applied it to 34 randomly selected tasks from an 80-task snapshot during the development of Harbor-Index v0.1. The snapshot drew from 29 source benchmarks spanning diverse domains and evaluation procedures ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Many tasks had been reimplemented in a shared format, creating additional opportunities for defects in instructions, environments, and grading logic.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估该工作流能否迁移到 Terminal-Bench 之外，我们将其应用于从 80 个任务的快照中随机选取的 34 个任务，该快照是在 Harbor-Index v0.1 的开发过程中生成的。 该快照取自 29 个源基准，涵盖多样的领域和评估流程（Shi et al., 2026）。 许多任务已以共享格式重新实现，这为指令、环境和评分逻辑中的缺陷创造了额外的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The Harbor team manually reviewed all 34 tasks, including those the workflow did not flag. The workflow flagged 14 tasks, of which manual review confirmed 12 as defective (86% precision). Findings included instruction–verification mismatches, infrastructure failures, and dependencies on mutable external state. For example, several GAIA2 tasks rejected correct reference solutions because an auxiliary grading service was invoked under the wrong condition. In GSO, instructions omitted a condition required by the grader.
paragraphs.zh: Harbor 团队人工审查了全部 34 个任务，包括工作流未标记的任务。 工作流标记了 14 个任务，其中人工审查确认 12 个存在缺陷（86% 的精确率）。 发现的问题包括指令与验证不匹配、基础设施故障，以及对可变外部状态的依赖。 例如，若干 GAIA2 任务拒绝了正确的参考解，因为一个辅助评分服务在错误的条件下被调用。 在 GSO 中，指令遗漏了评分器所需的一个条件。

paragraphs.en: Manual review also identified defects the workflow missed: an incorrect reference answer in Lab-Bench, nondeterministic grading in QCircuitBench, and an HLE instruction admitting two plausible correct answers. Two additional bugs in shared grading code affected 13 tasks, overlapping with tasks already flagged for other defects: the GSO grader executed the agent-produced program twice, and the GAIA2 grader mishandled special characters.
paragraphs.zh: 人工复核还发现了工作流遗漏的缺陷：Lab-Bench 中一个错误的参考答案、QCircuitBench 中不确定的评分，以及 HLE 中一道指令允许两个似乎都正确的答案的题目。 共享评分代码中的另外两个缺陷影响了 13 个任务，与已因其他缺陷被标记的任务有所重叠：GSO 评分器执行了智能体生成的程序两次，而 GAIA2 评分器对特殊字符处理不当。

paragraphs.en: The results show that the workflow can identify defects beyond Terminal-Bench. The missed cases motivate further investigation of benchmark-specific checks, repeated execution, and domain expertise. The Harbor-Index team subsequently extended validation with trajectory-level judges and further rounds of review and repair; we refer readers to Shi et al. (2026) for details.

paragraphs.en: This is the case for version control rather than one-shot validation: each release should be a numbered dataset, pinned to task-level digests, with a public record of what changed. LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) already operates this way for contamination control; the same discipline applies to task-side defects.
paragraphs.zh: 这应当采用版本控制的方式而非一次性验证：每个版本发布都应是一个带编号的数据集，固定到任务级摘要（digest）上，并以公开记录说明哪些内容发生了变更。 LiveCodeBench（Jain 等，2025）在污染控制方面已经采用了这种方式；同样的纪律也适用于任务侧的缺陷。

paragraphs.zh: 在全部 19 个智能体上，TB2.0 与 TB2.1 之间的排名高度相关（Spearman ρ = 0.958 \rho=0.958），但单个智能体的分数变化幅度可达 12 个百分点，排行榜上的位置最多可移动三位。 因此，在这些修复之下，整体排序保持稳定，但绝对性能估计值以及相邻智能体之间的比较可能取决于基准测试的版本。

sents.en: Thus, the broad ordering is stable under these repairs, but absolute performance estimates and comparisons between nearby agents can depend on the benchmark version.

paragraphs.en: The largest gains concentrate on instruction–verification mismatches, the most prevalent defect category. The audit also shows the sensitivity of efficiency conclusions to different design choices, and how setting a feasibility floor is an affordable fix.
paragraphs.zh: 最大的收益集中在指令与验证不匹配这一最普遍的缺陷类别上。 该审计还展示了效率结论对不同设计选择的敏感性，以及设置可行性下限为何是一种代价可承受的补救措施。

paragraphs.en: Overall, this work provides (i) an audit methodology that surfaces and repairs benchmark defects; (ii) the TB2.1 artifact, demonstrating that audit-driven repairs can preserve agent rank ordering while shifting absolute scores; and (iii) evidence that, on TB2.1, both task definitions and resource budgets shape published scores in ways current reporting practice does not control for. Finally, because this pipeline can run continuously, Terminal Bench 2.1 is a checkpoint rather than a terminal state.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这项工作提供了：（i）一种能够发现并修复基准测试缺陷的审计方法；（ii）TB2.1 成果，表明审计驱动的修复能够在保持智能体排名次序的同时改变绝对分数；以及（iii）证据表明，在 TB2.1 上，任务定义与资源预算都会以当前报告实践未能控制的方式影响已发表的分数。 最后，由于该流水线可以持续运行，Terminal Bench 2.1 是一个检查点，而非终点。

paragraphs.en: As benchmark users continue to open issues and pull requests, maintainers need a lightweight way to check whether proposed changes preserve task validity. We implement this audit workflow with GitHub Actions that can be invoked manually or triggered automatically on pull requests for a given task.
paragraphs.zh: 随着基准测试用户不断提交 issue 和 pull request，维护者需要一种轻量级的方法来检查所提议的更改是否保持了任务的有效性。 我们使用 GitHub Actions 实现了这一审计工作流，既可以手动调用，也可以在针对给定任务的 pull request 上自动触发。

paragraphs.en: /audit calls the auditor agent to review the task instructions and available trial logs.
paragraphs.zh: /audit 会调用审计员智能体来审查任务说明和可用的试验日志。

paragraphs.en: /oracle builds the task environment and runs the reference solution, checking that a known-correct solution still passes.
paragraphs.zh: /oracle 构建任务环境并运行参考解决方案，检查一个已知正确的解决方案是否仍然通过。

paragraphs.en: Although agents could be given permission to propose fixes and merge pull requests automatically, we deliberately restrict the workflow to propose-only operation. Each run is capped at five repair iterations, and the workflow grants pull-requests but prevents agents from directly changing repository state. Instead, proposed fixes are emitted as maintainer-reviewable diffs in audit/changes/<task>.diff .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管可以为智能体授予提议修复并自动合并拉取请求的权限，我们有意将该工作流限制为仅提议模式。 每次运行最多进行五轮修复迭代，且该工作流仅授予拉取请求，阻止智能体直接更改仓库状态。 相反，提议的修复会以可供维护者审查的 diff 形式输出到 audit/changes/<task>.diff 中。

Managed coding assistants, Claude Code (Opus 4.6) and Codex (GPT-5.4), agree on the primary defect category, including no defect , at κ = 0.80 \kappa=0.80 over all 89 tasks. Lower-cost API auditors are evaluated on the binary triage decision (flagged vs. clean) over all 89 TB2.0 tasks ( Table 1 ), with pairwise agreement of κ = 0.55 \kappa=0.55 – 0.77 0.77 . Because every drift defect breaks the reference solution, the deterministic /oracle check catches drift regardless of auditor labels.

paragraphs.en: Z.ai released Terminal-Bench 2.0 Verified [ Z.ai, 2026 ] , an earlier public audit of TB2.0. Terminal-Bench 2.0 Verified makes two kinds of changes. First, environment fixes applied to all 89 tasks make the task images run under the Claude Code runtime: for example, installing procps , whose absence crashed the agent, and capping the cores visible to caffe-cifar-10 so that parallel builds no longer run out of memory. Z.ai reports that these fixes alone raise Claude Opus 4.5 from 52.4% to 57.9%, an early demonstration that environment defects, not only task content, move leaderboard scores. Second, instruction fixes correct 11 tasks whose instructions and tests disagree.
paragraphs.zh: Z.ai 发布了 Terminal-Bench 2.0 Verified [ Z.ai, 2026 ]，这是对 TB2.0 的一次较早的公开审计。 Terminal-Bench 2.0 Verified 做了两类更改。 首先，应用于全部 89 个任务的环境修复使任务镜像能够在 Claude Code 运行时下运行：例如，安装 procps（其缺失会导致智能体崩溃），并限制 caffe-cifar-10 可见的内核数，以使并行构建不再耗尽内存。 Z.ai 报告称，仅这些修复就能将 Claude Opus 4.5 的成绩从 52.4% 提升到 57.9%，这早期地表明，不仅任务内容，环境缺陷也会影响排行榜分数。 其次，指令修复纠正了 11 个指令与测试不一致的任务。

paragraphs.en: We note two core differences. paragraphs.en: We note that terminus-2 triggers proactive summarization when the free context drops below a threshold (default 8K tokens). We leave the default for frontier-API models and GLM 5.1, where a single turn rarely exceeds 8K tokens. paragraphs.en: Agentic evaluation infrastructure is still a work in progress: runner failures, provider interruptions, authentication errors, sandbox crashes, and setup timeouts can all occur before the agent has produced a task-level outcome. To avoid mixing these infrastructure failures with model behavior, this analysis uses a conservative whitelist-filtering approach. The table builder retains only trials whose terminal state can be interpreted as an agent outcome: a pass, a completed but wrong answer, or an AgentTimeoutError . Timed-out trials are still graded on the state the agent left, and 11.8% of graded timeouts pass. Other upstream infrastructure errors are filtered before the decomposition is computed. However, we note that these filtered infrastructure trials account for roughly 27 % 27\% of upstream trials.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式评测基础设施仍处于建设过程中：运行器故障、供应商中断、认证错误、沙箱崩溃以及环境配置超时，都可能在智能体产出任务级结果之前发生。 为了避免将这些基础设施故障与模型行为混为一谈，本分析采用了保守的白名单过滤方法。 表格构建器仅保留其终止状态可被解读为智能体结果的试验：通过、已完成但答案错误，或 AgentTimeoutError。 超时的试验仍会根据智能体留下的状态进行评分，且被评分的超时试验中有 11.8% 通过。 其他上游基础设施错误会在计算分解之前被过滤掉。 不过，我们注意到这些被过滤的基础设施试验约占上游试验的 27%。
